front: Khái niệm 'Past Simple vs Past Continuous' trong Unit 1: Life Stories We Admire được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Past continuous describes an action in progress in the past when another shorter action (Past simple) interrupted it: When S + V(past simple), S + was/were V-ing; or While S + was/were V-ing, S + V(past simple).

💡 Ví dụ: While Uncle Ho was working abroad, he traveled to many countries to find a way to liberate Vietnam.
🌱 Bản chất: Expressing background context and specific interrupting events in historical narrative.

front: Khái niệm 'Compound Adjectives' trong Unit 1: Life Stories We Admire được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Adjectives formed by joining two or more words (often with a hyphen) such as well-known, warm-hearted, hard-working, open-minded.

💡 Ví dụ: General Vo Nguyen Giap was a world-famous military strategist admired by people globally.
🌱 Bản chất: Enriching descriptions of character traits and personal achievements concisely.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Usage of While and When with Past tenses'?
back:
Use 'While' before continuous long actions (While + Past Continuous); use 'When' before sudden short actions (When + Past Simple) or concurrent events.

📝 Ví dụ: When I arrived home, my family was having dinner.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Time relationships must match the aspectual nature of the events.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Combine two sentences using 'when' or 'while': 'Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree.' and 'An apple fell on his head.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Identify the continuous background action: sitting under an apple tree -> Past Continuous.
Step 2: Identify the short interrupting action: an apple fell -> Past Simple.
Step 3: Combine with 'while': While Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree, an apple fell on his head.
Step 4: Alternative with 'when': Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree when an apple fell on his head.

👉 Kết luận: While Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree, an apple fell on his head.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Using Past Continuous for stative verbs: *While I was knowing the answer*.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Using Past Continuous for stative verbs: *While I was knowing the answer*.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: Stative verbs (know, understand, believe, love) are not used in continuous aspect; use Past Simple instead: While I knew the answer.
